title: Three ways to climb to the third step
summary: Three step-by-step paths show the distinct ways to reach step 3.
context: Numbering the ground level as 0, each move climbs 1 or 2 steps, with the goal of landing on step 3.
description: From left to right, the stairs are numbered 0 through 6, with the tread of target step 3 highlighted in green. Three sets of jump arcs are drawn above the same staircase, matching the step sequences listed below; a caption beneath the staircase notes, "There are 3 ways to reach step 3."

frames.title: Three ways to climb to the third step
frames.explanation: The solid cyan path advances along steps 0 → 1 → 2 → 3, climbing 1 step three times in a row; the dotted blue path follows 0 → 2 → 3, climbing 2 steps to step 2 and then 1 step to step 3; the dashed orange path follows 0 → 1 → 3, climbing 1 step to step 1 and then 2 steps to step 3. Climbing 2 steps then 1 step visits a different intermediate step from climbing 1 step then 2 steps, so the two count as distinct ways.
